title_zh: 不要把拼图成绩等同于整体智力

scenario.label_zh: 审视拼图成绩的推论边界
scenario.goal_zh: 区分特定任务表现与整体智力，并依据练习影响修订课堂研究结论

context_zh: 两名学生讨论虚构课堂小实验的报告，准备缩小结论范围。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: We finished the puzzle faster on our second attempt. Can we say that the exercise increased our intelligence?

sentences.speaker: Yusuf
sentences.text: That seems too broad. It is one mental task, and we already knew how the puzzle worked on the second attempt.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: The group generally finished faster the second time, though two people did not.

sentences.speaker: Yusuf
sentences.text: That does indeed show a change in performance on this puzzle. It does not tell us what happened to every other ability.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: Then we should describe the faster times without claiming an overall change in ability.

sentences.speaker: Yusuf
sentences.text: Yes, and mention that practice could explain the difference. We did not include a group that was seeing the puzzle for the first time.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: I will rewrite the conclusion around those results and add the missing comparison as a limitation.

sentences.speaker: Yusuf
sentences.text: Good. I will check that our chart includes the two people whose times did not improve.
